name: anatomy_monster_gold_quadraphract_032

source_visual_profile.source_description: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its legs are smooth faceted figures, with no visible joints, and hold its gem-like body aloft with an eery, sculpted grace.  At the peak of the gem-body is a deep, goblet-shaped crown that slowly swivels about, pointing at nothing in specific.  Though nothing about its appearance is familiar to you, it nevertheless strikes you with a mixture of awe and dread.
